assumptions.ERA_rounding: League calibration uses IP-weighted official two-decimal ERA.
assumptions.pitcher_role: Current roster role; mixed-role game history is not modeled.
assumptions.batting_RC: (H + BB + HBP) * TB / (AB + BB + HBP); basic RC extended with HBP.
assumptions.batting_baseline: Only fully reconciled players in the same league.

history_note: 基本成績取自 2026-10-02 官方球員快照。逐場紀錄只保存 705 場；缺漏的進階數據留空，FIP 與投手 WAR 仍按官方累計及可用基準估算。
